title: GO:1905523: t-SNE of Conjoint triad
caption: t-SNE projection of all 268 proteins in the GO:1905523 pool, described by Conjoint triad (343 dimensions). Silhouette of the two classes in the 2-D map: 0.25. Axes have no units, and distances between far-apart clusters are not meaningful. Positives are drawn on top of negatives.
